main.description: Grantee-signed request to revoke their own access to an asset governed by an owner-repo passport receipt.

granteeDid.description: DID of the grantee requesting removal (must match the repo author).

manifestCid.description: Metadata manifest CID of the asset whose access is being revoked (drive index or entry name leaf; never the file byte CID).

ownerDid.description: DID of the file owner whose passport receipt governs the asset.

receiptUri.description: AT URI of the owner-repo cloud.substratum.passport.receipt record.

requestedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the grantee requested removal.
